description: This file defines a Widget for iOS using SwiftUI and ActivityKit. It implements a live activity widget with dynamic island and lock screen views, showing status indicators and different UI elements based on the activity state.

classes.name: OpenClawLiveActivity
classes.description: A SwiftUI Widget conforming to Widget protocol, providing live activity UI with dynamic island and lock screen views, representing the open claw status.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the widget's configuration, integrating activity and dynamic island views.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Builds the lock screen view showing status dot, label, and trailing view based on activity context.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Provides a view that reflects the current activity state, such as progress, icons, or timer.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Creates a small circle view indicating status color.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color for the status dot based on activity state.
